name: auto-compact-trim-then-summary
about: Web search on, build tools and elision before turns off, the background pass off (COMPACT_BACKGROUND_AT 0), a 12000-token window with 1000 for the reply. A search brings five long results; once a turn would pass AUTO_COMPACT_THRESHOLD the history is compacted without the model (the old search result elided, under COMPACT_TRIM_TARGET); later, with no tool output left, an auto-compaction summarises all but the newest turn, and a third appends an incremental summary after the first.
